title: He wants to know if/why/what/when
translation: 他想知道是否/为什么/什么/什么时候
description: A picture lesson on indirect (reported) questions. Six pictures show different scenarios: if a man is a teacher, why Mary teaches here, if a girl speaks English, what Graham is writing, if they are coming soon, when she is leaving. The lesson introduces written exercises A (answer questions about the Lesson 139 dialogue), B (write 'He/She wants to know if/why/what/when...' sentences), and C (answer questions with indirect questions). The workbook drills indirect-question completion and open-ended 'Situations'; the grammar workbook completes indirect-question dialogue items, rewrites direct questions as indirect questions, and writes short reports with indirect questions.
answer_note: Grammar I–II and their answers are restored from PDF pp.426–428 and575–577. Other sections retain their recorded sources. Grammar source audit: see reports/grammar-source-audit.json; source section order, complete prompts and answers restored.

lesson.text: Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

1. Sue: Is that man a teacher? → Sue wants to know if that man is a teacher.
2. John: Why does Mary teach here? → John wants to know why Mary teaches here.
3. Ben: Does that girl speak English? → Ben wants to know if that girl speaks English.
4. Julie: What is Graham writing? → Julie wants to know what Graham is writing.
5. Gary: Are they coming soon? → Gary wants to know if they are coming soon.
6. Jim: When is she leaving? → Jim wants to know when she is leaving.
lesson.translation: 1. 苏：那个男人是老师吗？→ 苏想知道那个男人是否是老师。 2. 约翰：玛丽为什么在这里教书？→ 约翰想知道玛丽为什么在这里教书。 3. 本：那个女孩会说英语吗？→ 本想知道那个女孩是否会说英语。 4. 朱莉：格雷厄姆在写什么？→ 朱莉想知道格雷厄姆在写什么。 5. 加里：他们很快就要来吗？→ 加里想知道他们是否很快就要来。 6. 吉姆：她什么时候离开？→ 吉姆想知道她什么时候离开。

lesson.title: Written A: Answer the questions (about Lesson 139)

questions.prompt: Is Graham Turner telephoning from his office?
questions.answer: Yes, he is.

questions.prompt: What message does he want John to give Mary?

questions.prompt: What did Mary invite Charlotte and Graham to? And when?
questions.answer: She invited them to dinner this evening.

questions.prompt: Why can't Graham and Charlotte be at John's house at six o'clock?

practice.title: Practice B: Situations
practice.instruction: Read these situations. What might you say in each? 根据以下情景写出你应该说的话。
practice.translation: 根据以下情景写出你应该说的话。
practice.context: 2 open-ended situation questions; the workbook answer key gives only possible sample answers.

questions.prompt: Your phone rings. When you pick it up, a voice says: 'Is that you, [your name]?' What do you say?
questions.answer: (Yes,) speaking.

questions.prompt: Someone tells you something which you do not understand at all. It all seems a mystery to you. What do you say?
